title: Quenched Nutty German Pork Stew
description: A hearty German stew featuring pork, garlic, and a nutty flavor profile, all cooked to perfection in a cataplana vessel. This dish is high in protein and perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat the butter in the cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Sprinkle the flour over the pork and garlic, stirring to combine.
Gradually add the beef broth, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chopped hazelnuts and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional hazelnuts if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
